dedupe_keys.name: basisregistratie gewaspercelen brp crop parcels netherlands

description: The Basisregistratie Gewaspercelen (BRP) is the Dutch national dataset of agricultural parcels with the crop grown on each, extracted from the Basisregistratie Percelen, with boundaries based on the Agrarisch Areaal Nederland reference layer. Farmers must delineate their crop parcels and declare the crops every year, and the dataset is produced by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland, RVO) and published through the national geodata platform PDOK. Coverage is the whole of the Netherlands at parcel level, with annual editions using 15 May as reference date. Data are served free through WMS, WFS, OGC API Features and an ATOM download service, and can be previewed in the PDOK viewer; the page read does not state a licence or file formats. Caveats: crops are declared by farmers for subsidy purposes, so parcels outside the scheme and later crop changes are missed, and the documentation is in Dutch. For simulation it gives parcel-level crop exposure for flood, drought and salinisation impact models, for example estimating agricultural damage when dikes fail or water is rationed, and supports climate adaptation planning of water management. It is related to the Harmonized World Soil Database record in this catalogue, which adds soil properties for crop and water models.
